CSBC Bihar Police Constable GD Special Branch Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

CSBC Bihar Police Constable GD Special Branch Admit Card 2026. Candidates can now download their admit card / hall ticket from the official website before the exam date. The last date to apply is 06/02/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Apply Online Start Date : 06/02/2026
  • Apply Online Last Date : 05/03/2026

  • Download Admit Card : Click Here

Application Fee

  • Apply Online Start Date : 06/02/2026
  • Apply Online Last Date : 05/03/2026
  • Last Date Upload Documents : 05/03/2026
  • General / OBS / EWS : Rs. 100/-
  • SC / ST / EXs : Rs. 100/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
